hero.eyebrow: The mobile app for visiting museums
hero.subtitle: Scan exhibits with your camera, get instant answers from AI, and follow personalized itineraries through museums. Romanian culture, a tap away.

functionalities.title: The
functionalities.subtitle: Explore partner museums in a fully interactive way. Find hidden exhibits through clever clues, scan them with your phone, and turn every visit into a captivating cultural game.

discover.title: Discover
discover.description: Use curators' clues and the interactive map to locate the painting, sculpture, or historical object. Every exhibit has a story that guides you straight to its location.

scan.title: Scan
scan.description: Once you've located the exhibit, point your phone's camera at it. Our smart visual recognition algorithm identifies it instantly and credits your account with
scan.bonusSubtitle: Points are stored in your explorer profile.

quiz.title: Test yourself
quiz.description: Get ready to put your attention and freshly gained knowledge to the test. Correctly answer 2 quick quiz questions about the exhibit you found to earn substantial bonus points.

cta.title: Ready to start the
cta.subtitle: Download the arte·fact app right now and start the most interactive adventure through Romania's museums.

camera.title: AR Camera
camera.description: Point your camera at any exhibit and get detailed information instantly. Visual recognition trained on Romanian heritage.

ai.title: Ask AI
ai.description: Ask any question about the objects in the museum. The AI gives you historical context, comparisons, and fascinating stories instantly.

itinerary.title: Your Itinerary
itinerary.description: Get an optimized route through the museums, with estimated time and recommended order. Your visit, perfectly planned.

admin.title: A dashboard built for museums and admins

cookieConsent.title: We value your privacy
cookieConsent.description: We use cookies to understand how you use Artefact and to improve your experience. You can accept or reject non-essential cookies at any time.
